dct_title_s: King County, Washington : sewer basin regions
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Water Pollution Control Division (WPCD) defined boundaries for sewer basin regions. Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties. Derived from the King County Wastewater Treatment Division's sewer flow basins coverage.

Purpose: This datalayer contains polygons showing sewer basin region areas in King, Pierce, and Snohomish counties. This layer is used for modelling and planning wastewater flows. This layer does NOT represent the King County Wastewater Treatment Service Area.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
